desc: 薄款长裤束脚版型，弹力腰头与织纹布面，主打清爽不闷热
leaf: 夏季速干束脚薄款休闲长裤
name: 夏季速干薄款束脚休闲裤款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清裤型与束脚，干净合规拿下第一跳点击。
用冷雾与暗底把「清爽不闷热」这一条核心利益压到一秒可读。
shots.textZone: upper left third, headline slot only

shots.intent: 把夏天裤子贴在腿上的黏腻感放大，再让同一裤型在凉风里松开。
用织纹纵深证明布面会排汗透气，替参数屏提供可见证据。
看清腰头与绳扣的工艺与回弹结构，消除勒腰与变形的疑虑。
用后片整形状讲清立体剪裁，回答穿上会不会垮塌卡臀。
把束脚收边的比例感做实，解释显高显瘦来自脚口而不是修图。
承接源页的规格屏结构，用空白量位线与空指示轨消解选码疑虑。
shots.textZone: top band holds two short label slots

shots.intent: 把裤型放进早晨通勤的真实一瞬，让买家代入而不是看参数。
一次看全配色与折叠后的体量，让选色这一步在详情页里就完成。
用洗护图示与留空凭证位收住风险，把成交前的最后一道顾虑关掉。
shots.textZone: pine-ink band, one short label slot

style.backgroundSystem: mist-porcelain field #F2F7F3 alternating with deep pine-ink header bands #16302E and silver-frost secondary boards #C9D8D5, one condensation-misted glass plane for the single scene screen, no scenic depth and no gradient sweep anywhere
style.iconSystem: letterless outlined square glyph frames set on a single hairline rail, no filled, shaded or pictorial icons and no seal artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool even studio light near 6000K, broad frontal key with a white fill card on the shadow side, texture lifted only by a skimming sweep, exactly one clean grounded contact shadow per frame
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool glacier-mint performance menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist-porcelain field #F2F7F3, deep pine-ink header bands #16302E, silver-frost secondary surfaces #C9D8D5 and one lake-teal accent #3F9AA8; cool even studio light near 6000K with a broad frontal key, a white fill card on the shadow side and one clean grounded contact shadow only; narrow geometric grotesque for every rendered line with letterspaced micro labels in the lake-teal accent, no serif, no script, no retro lettering; graphic components limited to pine-ink hairline rules, dashed leader-line schematics, letterless outlined square glyph frames and blank rounded pill chips, every copy slot left empty; garment shown with a straight leg line, waistband at the top edge of any crop and the tapered hem always readable, no hanger and no mannequin; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no scenic depth blur, no invented fabric or measurement facts.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #F2F7F3, #16302E, #C9D8D5 and #3F9AA8
no hanger, rail, clip, mannequin or visible model face in any frame
no invented fabric content percentages, gram weight, size numbers, care temperatures or index values
no serif, script, brush or retro lettering and no second display face
no gradient sweeps, glow, blurred drop shadows, scenic depth blur or duplicated background tiling
style.presentationRules: waistband always at the top edge of any crop, straight leg line kept unbroken, tapered hem readable in every frame, garment scale stable within plus or minus five percent across the set, no hanger and no mannequin
style.surfaceSystem: matte mist-porcelain counter #F2F7F3, silver-frost brushed board #C9D8D5 and a deep pine-ink insert #243B38 reserved for macro crops
style.typography: narrow geometric grotesque only, one short headline plus at most three letterless chips per screen, every rendered Chinese line carried as a bracketed placeholder
